terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: Welcome to SalePage (salepage.in.th) — a platform for building Thai online shops. By using our service you accept the following terms.

sections.p: SalePage provides a platform for online shops. Users must be 18+ (or have parental consent). You may create multiple shops under one account.

Starter is free forever. Pro ฿299/month and Business ฿790/month, billed via Stripe (includes 7% VAT). Cancel anytime — paid fees are non-refundable. SalePage charges no per-order fee — customers transfer money directly to your bank.

Shop owners are solely responsible for the goods and services sold in their shop. Illegal goods, IP infringement, and content violating community standards are prohibited. SalePage may suspend non-compliant shops.

sections.h: 3.1 Zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users
sections.p: SalePage has zero tolerance for objectionable content or abusive users — including pornographic/sexual content, violence, harassment, hate speech against race/religion/gender, fraud, counterfeit goods, illegal goods, and photos that violate other people's privacy. Every signed-in user can (1) report objectionable content via the “Report” button on every shop/product/review/message, and (2) block abusive users — blocking instantly hides their content from your feed and notifies us. We review every report and act within 24 hours: offending content is removed and the offending user is ejected from the platform.

The SalePage trademark and platform are owned by BANPUEN 911. User-generated content (products, images, descriptions) belongs to you — by using the service you grant us a license to store and display it as needed.
SalePage is a tool; we are not a money intermediary. Transfers between buyer and seller are the parties' direct responsibility. We strive for high uptime but do not guarantee 100%.
You may close your account and shops anytime in /dashboard/settings. SalePage may suspend accounts in cases of severe terms violations.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Thailand. Any dispute will be heard in Bangkok district courts.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: SalePage takes your privacy seriously and complies with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

sections.p: Email and name (from Google OAuth or magic-link), shop data (name, PromptPay, address), orders, payment slips (image + parsed fields from SlipOK), and session tokens.
To operate the platform, verify slips, send order email notifications, improve the service, and comply with the law.

We use the following providers to process data: Vercel (hosting/CDN), Neon (database, Singapore region), Stripe (subscription billing — shop-owner data only), SlipOK (slip verification — slip image + meta), Resend (email delivery), Google (OAuth sign-in), Cloudflare (DNS).
Order data is retained 5 years per Thai tax law. Account data is retained for the account lifetime — deleted on request.
You may access, correct, delete, restrict processing of, or export your data. Email hello@salepage.in.th — we respond within 30 days.
We use cookies for session persistence and language preference. No tracking/advertising cookies.
All traffic over TLS 1.3, no password storage (we use magic-link and Google OAuth), API keys stored in encrypted Vercel env vars.

accountDelete.title: Delete SalePage account
accountDelete.intro: You can request deletion of your SalePage account and all associated data at any time — either through the app or by email.
accountDelete.inAppTitle: Option 1 — Delete from inside the app
accountDelete.inAppBody: Fastest path. Takes a few seconds.
accountDelete.step1: Open the SalePage app and sign in.
accountDelete.step2: Tap the "Me" tab (rightmost in the bottom bar).
accountDelete.step3: Scroll to the bottom and tap "Delete account".
accountDelete.step4: Confirm — your data is removed immediately and you're signed out.
accountDelete.emailBody: Use this if you can no longer sign in. We'll verify and delete within 30 days.
accountDelete.scope1: Name, email, profile picture, and phone number
accountDelete.scope3: Order history, reviews, and saved recipient details
accountDelete.scope4: Linked LINE / Google / Apple accounts (unlinked from us)
accountDelete.scope5: Shops you own (suspended and hidden from search)
accountDelete.retention: Note — orders that are still in transit will remain until they're delivered so both buyer and seller can view their history. Your personal data is replaced with "Deleted user" immediately on deletion.
